create_chat_completion: create a chat completion call with messages and optional streaming for conversational AI
run_text_generation: run text generation from a prompt with configurable parameters like max_new_tokens and temperature
build_text_to_image: build an image from a text prompt using a diffusion model with optional negative prompt and guidance scale
test_audio_classification: test audio classification on an audio file to predict emotion labels with confidence scores
summarize_text: summarize a long text into a concise summary using a summarization model
